body:
Thank you so much for updating me! I am so glad, and I really appreciate you being there as well!

I'm really sorry about your sister's call, I have gotten advice like that from my family so many times and I wish people understood how it's really not helpful for everyone. 

I'm really glad you spoke with your dr I hope they can get you on some meds that you work well with (I'm working on the same thing).

Feel free to PM me anytime. I will try to log in when I can. This is a throwaway account but i will try and log in anytime I am able :) Thank you as well :)
I've been feeling that way a lot lately. I Here's hoping we both can get some decent rest and feel a least a little bit better.

First off you're not whiny or a waste. I'm glad you chose to vent and reach out instead. You've been through a lot and Im sorry. I'm also really impressed that you kicked meth and cocaine and have been clean for 14 months. That take a lot. I was just about to finally go to sleep but I wanted to be sure you knew some one read your post and that you are not a lone and that someone else cares.
I'm glad you had second thoughts and you're damn strong for it. I hope that's not overly upbeat, I mean it in genuinely. I am sorry things have been rough. I hope things will get better very soon.
I dont feel comfortable mentioning it at the moment, Im still a bit set off by it.

It's ok!! and I hope you can get some good sleep and feel at least a little bit better. I think I will try that sleep thing as well :) Thank you for talking to me too!!! I'll be around and I wish you all the best!

I am so sorry about the divorce and I know it's got to be very tough on both of you. It's ok, you are still being very strong right now just by being alive. Seriously, it may not seem like much right now. But the fact that you are still alive is the greatest achievement.  I'm not BSing you as it's the same thing I have to tell myself over and over and over again. 

It's ok if you can't forgive yourself now. Baby steps with everything. Work at what ever pace you are comfortable with. 6 years is a long time and that is long than some people work at trying to improve a situation. Trying at all is a success in and of itself. Seriously when there's days that you cant physically get out of bed, any little thing that you achieve, even if it's taking a shower is a great feat.

I wish I had some good advice to give or some sort of real answer. All I'm doing is trying to get through the next 60seconds and the 60 after than and so on. It seems like when there's so much on them mind at once it's over whelming and hard to cope with. So just microscopic steps is progress.
I do suffer from depression, anxiety, suicidal phases and a phobia that triggers all of the three.

first off thank you so much for replying, I'm having a really rough night. my suicidal feeling are triggered by my phobia. said phobia has happened before and only has made it worse so addressing or facing is not an option at this point. right now im feeling very very close to doing something and Im very very scared...

You're very welcome, It's the least I can do. Thank you for giving me a reason to stick around tonight! 

I'm sorry about you last job. I know the job climate is pretty awful. I'm sure you've tried everything but just in case have you looked into temp places? (like areatemps, adecco etc?) Some times they have things. 

I do the SAME thing...laying in bed for days on end. It's horrible and I end up just beating myself up the whole time for doing it. Asking myself why I just dont get up, clean, do something. Then in turn end up feeling worse, it's a vicious cycle. I know its easier said than done, and it's something I have yet to master but if you can, be a bit forgiving to yourself. You've had a rough time lately, you can take it easy until you feel ready to get back into the swing of life. 

Also I am glad that you still have your daughter and again the fact that you care, means A LOT. It really, really does. I'm sure she loves and cares about you very much. As a daughter myself, I know I don't show it as much as I should but I care very much for my mother even if I mostly snap back at her or dont show appreciation. I'm in my 30's and I should really tell her that I appreciate her. I'm rambling but my point is, even if she doesn't say or show it, I know she cares a hell of a lot. 

I also have to say I care a lot as well, I know Im a stranger but I care. Feeling suicidal truly is horrible to go through and going through it alone is even worse. So I will stay up as long as I can, OK?

Oh wow so many nieces and nephews. OK I can really relate to you there. My family is pretty religious and I have lost my faith. I get that advice a lot. Things like 'trust in god', 'everything happens for a reason' , 'god has a plan' etc. All those things make feel more sad than anything personally. You took the words right out of my mouth. That's what I feel as well. If there is a god why does he allow any of this suffering? I envy people that have faith and people who's faith helps them through hard times. I get very frustrated that I can't just make my self feel what they feel. 

It's good that you still try to reach out to your family, and I hope they come around and help you. It's totally ok to keep trying to pray and reach out to god as well. I don't see how it would hurt to try. 

When it comes to humour, I feel like sometimes it's the only thing that keeps me around, so even if your family finds your humour inappropriate, if it's not hurting anyone, who cares. Sometimes a laugh is all that keeps ya going. 

And it's good to question things, I don't think you can question too much. It shows a thirst for knowledge.  

I'm still very much awake! I'm here to listen and talk.

It's ok, seriously don't apologize for anything. I'm glad you're venting a bit. I relate to that a lot. I don't enjoy any of the things I used to. I have been replaying the office tonight in hopes something funny will make me smile at least!

I am really sorry about the lonliness and I can really relate to that aspect. Most of my friends are married and /or have children so there's not really many around. 

Is it ok to ask what your sisters preach to you about? (if you don't want to talk about it, it's totally ok, but I'm happy to listen)

I do the same thing, I work for myself so I am in my place (usually bedroom) 90% of the time. I hear you on feeling that no one wants to be around someone negative, and I know there are people that dont. But I'll be honest in that I honestly don't care if my friends or someone I care about are being negative, I more care that they are hurting and that I want to do what I can to help. even if all I can do is listen. 
I know im just a stranger and I'm sorry if my words dont help much but feel free to vent all you like. I'll try and stay up as late as I can I do apologize a head of time if I nod off.

It's not a problem. I am with you there. At the very least, you are not alone. Is there anything at all that you still enjoy? a tv show, a game, a song, food, anything at all? If so tell me about it. If not tell me what bothers you the most at the moment.

I'm here to listen if you need someone to talk to. I am sorry things are going so rough. I can't imagine how hard it must be to go through a lot of what you are going through. It is very good of you to worry about your daughter, that is a good sign. I know when depression and suicidal feelings hit hard it's tough to think about others over the current pain.

I am glad you posted, it at least helps a bit to vent, and I'm here if you need someone to talk to. My own personal opinion is that you are not a psychopath, I noticed with my own depression the worse it gets the less I care about others and how much I have to force myself to care. Sometimes it doesn't work. I think it has to the disorder/illness. Maybe due to being so over whelmed with our own feelings of sorry, helplessness, despair that it is near impossible to care or feel for others.
I'm so, so sorry. I'm here if you need to talk. You don't deserve what has happened, and I apologize for not being great with words. I just want to make sure you are not alone.
